findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: transcribe, summarize, find_clips, extract_clip, complete_upload, get_job_status · Private data: summarize, complete_upload, get_job_status, mpp_smoke_test, publish_to_youtube · Public sink: find_clips, extract_clip, extract_vertical_clip, complete_upload, get_job_status, publish_to_youtube, trigger_youtube_publish, get_youtube_publish_status · Destructive: transcribe, summarize, get_job_status, mpp_smoke_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: transcribe, summarize, find_clips, extract_clip, complete_upload, get_job_status · Private data: summarize, complete_upload, get_job_status, mpp_smoke_test, publish_to_youtube · Public sink: find_clips, extract_clip, extract_vertical_clip, complete_upload, get_job_status, publish_to_youtube, trigger_youtube_publish, get_youtube_publish_status · Destructive: transcribe, summarize, get_job_status, mpp_smoke_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
